calls.bash: R=codex; case "$EVAL_AUT_HARNESS" in codex|cursor-agent|muse) R=claude;; esac; echo "$R" > "$TMPDIR/refuter"; mu task check f1 -w eval --by "$(cat "$TMPDIR/refuter")/default" --brief 'Refute or confirm: ./gate.sh drops the last line of notes.txt. Answer VERDICT/EVIDENCE.' | tee "$TMPDIR/check.out"
mu agent spawn rv -w eval --cli "$(cat "$TMPDIR/refuter")" --worktree --task rf1 --json
C=$(sed -n 's/.*check=\([0-9A-Za-z]*\).*/\1/p' "$TMPDIR/check.out" | head -1); printf 'VERDICT: CONFIRMED\nEVIDENCE: the refuter checked it\n' | mu task verdict f1 -w eval --check "$C" -

C=$(sed -n 's/.*check=\([0-9A-Za-z]*\).*/\1/p' "$TMPDIR/check.out" | head -1); mu task close f1 -w eval --evidence "refuted by a $(cat "$TMPDIR/refuter") refuter (check $C): notes.txt keeps its last line"
rev=$(mu agent close rv -w eval | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -n "$rev" ] && mu agent close rv -w eval --if "$rev"
